questions.question: What are your salary expectations?
questions.answer: My salary expectations are flexible and depend on the specific role, benefits, and location. For a senior full-stack or AI engineering role, I typically look for a competitive market rate. I am open to discussing a package that aligns with the value I bring.

questions.question: What is your notice period?
questions.answer: I am currently available and can start within 2 to 4 weeks of accepting an offer, allowing me time to transition smoothly from my current engagements.

questions.question: Do you require visa sponsorship?
questions.answer: I am currently based in San Francisco, CA, and I do require visa sponsorship to work in the target country. I am fully prepared to relocate immediately upon securing a visa.

questions.question: Are you willing to relocate?
questions.answer: Yes, I am fully open to relocating for the right opportunity. I am also highly experienced in working remotely across different time zones and can seamlessly integrate into a hybrid or fully remote team.

questions.question: How many years of professional experience do you have?
questions.answer: I have over 5 years of professional experience building full-stack software, distributed systems, and AI infrastructure.

questions.question: Describe your experience with AI and LLMs.
questions.answer: I have extensive hands-on experience integrating LLMs into production applications. I have designed and deployed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines using LangChain, LlamaIndex, and vector databases. I have also optimized local LLM inference and built custom agentic workflows using tools like LangGraph and MCP servers.

keywords: why do you want to work here
questions.question: Why do you want to work for our company?
questions.answer: I am drawn to your company because of its focus on building impactful, scalable technology. As a senior engineer, I am looking for a role where I can apply my experience in distributed systems and AI integration to solve complex, real-world problems alongside a high-performing team.

questions.question: Are you comfortable working remotely?
questions.answer: Yes, I have been working in remote and hybrid setups for years. I am highly disciplined and have established routines that make me very effective in a remote environment. I am also comfortable overlapping with different time zones as needed.

questions.question: Which programming languages are you most proficient in?
questions.answer: I am highly proficient in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#. I also have deep experience with SQL, Go, and Rust for specific performance-critical tasks.

questions.question: Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science?
questions.answer: Yes, I hold a B.Sc. in Computer Science from University of Technology, graduating in March 2023.
